rounds.notes:
# ROUND 🔹1🔹

---

# POWERS💪
### [Smashing!](item_a7021e28-cb8a-4f39-aeb1-380525b3fea9)
- this power even after it's nerfs is still really good at giving you movement speed and lifesteal which will keep you alive a lot of the time

---

# ITEMS💰
## BUY💎
- This round you can basically pick up anything you want but my recommendations are
- ### [Heartbeat Sensor](item_2a4ffaf4-f14b-47d2-a267-0a0e83e87418) 
This item will give you a nice little constant speed boost
- ### [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) 
A nice little damage boost
- ### [Plasma Converter](item_25869f9a-9a29-4e19-96b6-9d8a28c59318) 
This items' lifesteal will also stack with [Smashing!](item_a7021e28-cb8a-4f39-aeb1-380525b3fea9) 

## OPTIONAL (Different Playstyles/Affordable Items)🗒️
- ### [Frenzy Amplifier](item_d4b0cfcb-14e9-4472-a688-680120217250) 
you can take this over [Heartbeat Sensor](item_2a4ffaf4-f14b-47d2-a267-0a0e83e87418) if you want but I personally like the constant consistent smaller speed boost over the short bigger speed boost
-  ### [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf) 
you can take this over  [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) if you prefer attack speed over weapon damage but I genuinely don't think it makes a difference which you one you go lol

---

# ROUND GOAL🏁
- ### Your goal for this round is basically just to play vanilla Reinhardt, Take space and be aggressive but don't go feeding in and gain as much money as you can

# ROUND 🔹2🔹

---

# ITEMS💰
## BUY💎
- ### [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7)
![Image](https://i.imgur.com/BWWGzdl.gif "small")
## SELL🗑️
- If you didn't get enough money from round 1 sell some of the green items to get [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7)
## OPTIONAL (Different Playstyles/Affordable Items)🗒️
- ### [Frenzy Amplifier](item_d4b0cfcb-14e9-4472-a688-680120217250)
If you have the money after buying [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) you can make the choice to sell [Heartbeat Sensor](item_2a4ffaf4-f14b-47d2-a267-0a0e83e87418) and grab [Frenzy Amplifier](item_d4b0cfcb-14e9-4472-a688-680120217250) instead if you want. 

This is because [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) will now be giving you a decent consistent speed boost so you will still be able to catch up to the enemies if they're running from you and you'll become even faster with eliminations

---

# ROUND GOAL🏁
- ### [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) lets us be a bit more aggressive and get away with it especially against heroes like [Orisa](hero_91644d44-1093-4f62-ac51-020975465e85) or [Mei](hero_36fd67f0-19df-4c50-add9-709cfb147cb0) but you will still explode if you're not careful so still play it like round 1 aka gain as much money as you can die as little as you can and be a menace

# ROUND 🔹3🔹

---

# POWERS💪
This is where you can choose your own path based on how rounds 1 and 2 went

### [Feeling the Burn](item_256f9e9c-c332-42f2-83d9-ad0d47e23399) 
- this is my go to choice for round 3 if I'm not getting absolutely destroyed in the first 2 rounds the burn you apply will proc [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) it's not a lot of healing but it definitely helps

### [To Me, My Friends!](item_9bd5bb9d-8026-4092-80c5-21e726c0969f) 
- if I feel like I'm exploding too much or not getting enough healing from my supports I'll take this instead which will give you the added benefit of charging shatter a lot faster with your self-healing

---

# ITEMS💰
## BUY💎
- ### [Nebula Conduit](item_476b7040-54c9-4f0c-8283-b4407f6809f8) 
I go with this no matter which path you decide on picking this up will help you survive a lot more synergizing with [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) quite well also it will allow your [Kiriko](hero_70a0ac5c-2a55-4fab-beeb-2f570886426f) if you have one to build her Kitsune Rush faster as well if she has  [Cleansing Charge](item_4721f307-30d2-4fc1-a10b-6de7141deb68) or plans to get it in a later round
## SELL🗑️
- ### If you're short on money you can now start selling the greens 
- ### [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0)
- ### [Plasma Converter](item_25869f9a-9a29-4e19-96b6-9d8a28c59318)
- ### [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf)
## OPTIONAL (Different Playstyles/Affordable Items)🗒️
- ### [Ironclad Cleats](item_afb5c28e-3980-4a7d-85be-785c32217c28)
You will only need this item if you're against a team that can easily boop you like [Lucio](hero_b38c5d54-a585-4545-b0b8-4d4b205b3768) [Orisa](hero_91644d44-1093-4f62-ac51-020975465e85) [Pharah](hero_0baf7420-ff13-4b92-81f7-ca21b61dacf9)
- ### [Crusader's Cure](item_e89b853c-2441-432b-b4eb-20bc4b1b0619)
You will only need this item if you're against a team that can apply Anti-Heal to you such as [Ana](hero_f1aee6cf-704f-455f-a100-ec882ebbe000) and or [Junker Queen](hero_4794d288-27d9-49e0-a1dd-ffe0f4de3ab1) but also I'd only suggest getting it if they are consistently applying the anti to you if you're doing well at blocking ana's nades or avoiding queen's ults you can still skip this and buy a different item
## If you picked [Feeling The Burn](item_256f9e9c-c332-42f2-83d9-ad0d47e23399)
- ### [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054)
This will give you a nice boost to your swing speed and movement speed 
- ### [Shieldbuster](item_9ee1f150-537d-40b9-b975-7820fb1c6a66)
I usually will take this item over [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054) if I'm against a tank with Armor or Shield Health like [Orisa](hero_91644d44-1093-4f62-ac51-020975465e85) or [Sigma](hero_646d9571-c40a-4403-b6c1-fb67adb6112d) otherwise no real reason 
## If you picked [To Me, My Friends!](item_9bd5bb9d-8026-4092-80c5-21e726c0969f)
- ### [Overclocked Barrier](item_e82af99e-3116-4867-b8a4-52c7dfd1d7e9)
If you're going down this path you're probably exploding and or not getting healed that much by your supports so I suggest grabbing this item as well this will make your shield more sturdy so you can survive longer just by holding your shield
- ### [Iron Eyes](item_f16d03a7-f20e-4a1d-a1f6-55863e163c03)
If you're against Hitscan DPS like [Cassidy](hero_3dd63854-7558-4344-86e4-b506f807129b) [Soldier: 76](hero_e1ac7ef5-4648-4998-b8b0-9e3da3e60546) [Reaper](hero_0449752f-1c58-487b-b9a0-ca727d784457) this will reduce the damage you take from getting headshot by them

---

# ROUND GOAL🏁
- ### Now that you have [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) and [Nebula Conduit](item_476b7040-54c9-4f0c-8283-b4407f6809f8) you can be more aggressive and take more risks the build isn't at turn your brain off and swing levels yet though so just play with maybe 2 brain cells instead of 1 and you'll have very few if any deaths and you'll be gettin' plenty of money as well

# ITEMS💰
## BUY💎
- ### [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643)

## OPTIONAL (Different Playstyles/Affordable Items)🗒️

- ### [Vishkar Condensor](item_086a91da-b65d-4047-8fc7-28a992078b1d)

# ROUND GOAL🏁
- ### You're starting to become a pretty large threat this round so just keep doing what you're doing, taking space, absorbing damage, not feeding and you're gonna be gucci

If you picked [To Me, My Friends!](item_9bd5bb9d-8026-4092-80c5-21e726c0969f) on Round 3
- ### [To Me, My Friends!](item_9bd5bb9d-8026-4092-80c5-21e726c0969f) 
If you picked [Feeling The Burn](item_256f9e9c-c332-42f2-83d9-ad0d47e23399) on Round 3
- ### [Barrier Reconstruction](item_ecd5cf3c-0293-42e9-b015-0b00c25082f5)

# ROUND 🔹7🔹

---

# POWERS💪
## **IT'S THE FINAL ROUND**
### And if you're on this round both teams are probably pretty evenly matched so your choices here will heavily depend how the other 6 rounds went because of that I'm just going to list my suggestions for a few different outcomes and you pick based on what you think will help best! 

- ### [Amplification Barrier](item_a04d01ac-ead8-4b78-ba9a-32cc430041a1)
As stated in Round 5 if your DPS are popping off and sticking by you getting this will help them secure more elims meaning more team fight wins! 

- ### [Shield Stampede](item_0c4ef690-6472-48fe-9257-864c4381f584)
This Power lets you get into your hammer's range a lot more safely as well as increasing your charge's hitbox so you might be able to secure a few charge or environmental elims! 

- ### [Barrier Reconstruction](item_ecd5cf3c-0293-42e9-b015-0b00c25082f5)
Once again if you need your shield to last just that extra bit longer this will replenish some of it's health each time you deal damage with your hammer or fire strikes! 

- ### [Vanguard](item_228cf103-0be8-4f1c-8780-f3a8d8676abf)
If you've notice you've been able to charge a lot without being punished this power would be a good choice as it will give your teammates some overhealth each time you charge keeping them alive longer! 

---

# ITEMS💰
- ### [Vanadium Injection](item_57953fbc-11ff-4e92-9928-fc59b7be668f)
This item will give you a very nice stat boost to a majority of your stats while at 100% ult charge this item's effects besides the 50 shield will only be active at full ult charge though so if you do pick it up make sure to only ult if you are certain it can secure a team fight win
- ### [Rüstung von Wilhelm](item_aea17a63-3f55-4f91-8f49-a7793fbc56c4)
A very nice boost to survivability with extra health, shields and armor!
- ### [Eye of the Spider](item_bbaf01d7-340d-4199-b738-86a98d68fe9b)
If you need that extra bit of damage on top of you being an unkillable tank you can pick up this item
- ### [Plan Z](item_8e9dc830-ad05-413a-bcc9-efc0a23d8625)
This item will give you bonus attack speed as your health gets lower and lower meaning you'll be able to proc your lifesteal more often

---

# ROUND GOAL🏁
- ### Win the match!
